title: TurtleWave MC
description: A unique, small server that's open exclusively in the summer seasons (3 months a year) where anyone can join and chill.
body:
This is a simple mod where people can get together and mess around.
You can adventure, fight, hunt, or just build bases and watch the sunset.

The server is active only during the summer season, so it's limited time every year.

We have basic rules that are easy to understand; they can be found in the Discord.
The server is not meant to be taken seriously, and stealing is frowned upon.
Please be respectful. We can see when you are online and what you are doing.

If you are going to break the rules, please at least ensure that the person you're doing it to is online.
